deficits.evidence: No footway on the left side of the road, people must walk in the roadway.
deficits.suggestion: Construct a continuous sidewalk along the left side of the road to provide a safe walking space for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: The right side footway is partly blocked by parked vehicles and other obstructions.
deficits.suggestion: Remove obstructions and ensure the right side footway is clear and accessible for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: Uneven and broken sections on the right side footway pose trip hazards.
deficits.suggestion: Repair and resurface the right side footway to eliminate trip hazards and ensure a smooth walking surface.

deficits.evidence: There is a demand for crossing due to shops and homes on both sides, but no crossing facility is present.
deficits.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing at this location to facilitate safe crossing for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: The street lighting is inadequate, especially in the urban area.
deficits.suggestion: Install additional street lights along the road to improve visibility and safety for both pedestrians and drivers.

ratings.reason: The left side lacks a dedicated footway, and there is sufficient space to build one.
Parked scooters and vehicles are clearly obstructing the right-side walking area.
The right-side footway shows visible cracks and uneven surfaces.
There are no marked crossings despite the presence of shops and residential buildings.
Street lighting poles are visible along the road, contradicting the claim that lighting is missing.
